paras: Application: Nissan 370Z Z34 (2009-2020) and Nissan Z RZ34 (2023+) – RHD and LHD Part Type: In-tank fuel hanger surge tank (FHST) with integrated regulator – pumps not included Part Number: 20-1822

The Radium Fuel Hanger Surge Tank (FHST) solves fuel starvation in the saddle-bag style OEM tank of the Nissan Z34 370Z and RZ34 Z, a common problem under aggressive driving such as track use. An internal surge tank (collector box) is installed in the opposite side of the OEM tank and works with the OEM module and venturi jet pumps, avoiding the cabin intrusion of a stand-alone surge tank.
hl: Verified Pumps: Walbro F90000267 / F90000274 / F90000285
In-Tank Surge Tank: Collector box in the opposite side of the saddle-bag tank
One or Two Surge Pumps: Second pump wired with an additional wiring kit
Integrated RA-series FPR: 1:1 adjustable with 360° swivel vacuum port and four 10-32 fittings
Gauge Included: Fuel pressure gauge supplied
Drop-in Installation: No body modification, grinding or bending
ft: Radium Engineering FHST for Nissan 370Z & Z 400Z | Walbro F90000267/274/285 Compatible (No Pumps)
